reported_issue: On staging, the Inventory Import preview did not work (no preview rendered), even though the imported parts were still visible in the app. On production the same file previewed as expected.
expected_after_fix: Selecting/submitting a valid inventory CSV renders a preview table of the parsed rows before import.
steps_i_followed: Created a valid CSV with the documented columns (name, part_number, uom, quantity, min_qty, max_qty, grid_location, purchase_price, core_price, vendor, manufacturer, category) and 3 ZZAUTOTEST rows
Selected the CSV via 'Select CSV File' and clicked 'Submit File'
Observed the preview table and captured the data-preview API response (did NOT click Import Inventory)
actual_now: The preview works. POST /api/data-import/data-preview returned HTTP 200 with the parsed columns, and the preview table rendered all 3 ZZAUTOTEST rows with correct values across every column (Name/Part_number/Uom/Quantity/Min_qty/Max_qty/Grid_location/Purchase_price/Core_price/Vendor/Manufacturer/Category). The action buttons switched to 'Clear File' / 'Import Inventory'.
notes: Preview renders correctly before import. I intentionally did not click 'Import Inventory', so no parts were actually imported into staging. Note: the preview appears after clicking 'Submit File' (selecting the file alone does not populate the table).
